newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers slip, led by Gulf Coast.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers slip, led by Gulf Coast.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed on Thursday, traders said, with Houston fuel slipping at least seven dollars a tonne after a heavy morning selloff.
Houston 380 CST tumbled from its early-morning price of $119 a tonne to as low as $106 by midday, players said, but then clawed its way to recapture half the lost ground.
"The sellers came out and it dropped so much that a floor was created and it came rebounding back," one trader said, noting offers stood at about $112 by late afternoon.
Prices of New York 380 CST edged about $3 lower, players said, to between $126 and $128, with 180 CST offered at $132.
On the West Coast, Los Angeles 380 CST slipped $1 to $123, while Seattle material also fell $1 to $130, traders said.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632
